newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ACCC TO ALLOW IN FLETCHER BUY.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ACCC TO ALLOW IN FLETCHER BUY.

text.p: Anti-monopolies authority, the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) said on Wednesday it would not intervene in the proposed purchase of the remaining 50 percent of Australian Newsprint Mills by Fletcher Challenge Ltd.

"Australian Newsprint Mills is currently owned jointly by News Ltd and Fletcher Challenge and is the only manufacturer of newsprint and related grade paper in Australia," ACCC chairman Allan Fels said in a statement.
Fels said Fletcher has overseas mills in New Zealand and Canada, which account for a major share of the newsprint and related grade paper imports to Australia each year.

"Nevertheless, Fletcher Challenge faces substantial import competition from paper manufacturers in Scandinavia, South Africa and Asia," he said. News Ltd is the Australian arm of Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd .

Fels said mills in Indonesia and South Korea in particular were expected to significantly expand their capacity in the forseeable future and were well placed to increase their share of the Australian market.
This competition was likely to prevent Fletcher Challenge from increasing its prices or margins in Australia.
"Under these circumstances, the ACCC does not believe that the acquisition is likely to substantially lessen competition," Fels said.
Fletcher Paper is the biggest division of the New Zealand based industrial and resource group, which also has forestry, energy and building divisions.
